name: Impossible
overview: Scripture reveals that nothing is impossible for the LORD, who created the heavens and the earth by His great power and sovereign will. God’s ability to accomplish what seems beyond human reach is affirmed in His promise to fulfill His purposes at the appointed time, as seen in His assurance that Sarah would bear a son despite natural impossibility. Believers are called to seek God’s kingdom and righteousness first, trusting that He will provide all that is needed, demonstrating that with God, obstacles are not barriers but opportunities for His power to be displayed.
